subject: Mobile Development
title: Alternative App Stores Arriving
description: Learn Alternative App Stores Arriving in one minute.

hook.text: For the first time, third-party app stores are launching on the iPhone in Europe.

buildup.text: Epic Games, AltStore, and others applied to run their own iOS app marketplaces.

discovery.text: Each alternative store must meet Apple's notarization requirements and security standards.

twist.text: Apple charges a Core Technology Fee of €0.50 per install over one million. Critics call it a poison pill.

climax.text: Whether alternative stores succeed depends on whether Apple's fees make them viable.

punchline.text: The gates opened — with a toll booth attached.

quiz.question: What fee does Apple charge alternative stores in Europe?
